_readme: The warden's default line, named by the NPC in the map. The game's hooks return false
when they have nothing better to say, and this is what runs then - which is the whole
shape of the seam: a game takes the cases it cares about and leaves the rest to data.

greet.speaker: Warden
greet.text: The gate is barred, and I am the one who barred it. Nothing personal.

why.speaker: Warden
why.text: The key went into the hollow, west of here, some years ago. I did not put it there and I am not going to fetch it.

good.speaker: Warden
good.text: Then you are already doing more than I have in a decade.

fair.speaker: Warden
fair.text: It is. And it will still be my problem tomorrow.
